tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum dril sgrub zhal thang 'bring po'i bkod yig bzhugs so// ༈ /zhal thang 'bring po'i bkod yig ni/ oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi zhal thang bkod pa 'bring po kun go gcig chod kyi bkod yig la/ dbus su bla ma kun 'dus padma 'byung gnas snang srid zil gnon sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa/ zhal ras zhi zhing sgeg la spyan lta stangs hrig ge ba hur bag lta bu'i khro nyams dang*/ zhal 'dzum zhing cung khro nyams/ na bza' nang du gsang gos dkar po/ de steng phod ka mthing nag gser ris can/ de steng chos gos dmar po/ de steng snam sbyar dmar ser le'u la gser kyi me gor rtsing zhad yod pa/ de steng gos ber dmar smug gser gyi 'brug ris sogs ci mdzes/ dbu zhwa she'u'i snyan zhu zhes sha ba chung ngu'i pags pas nang gi kha dril byas pa rgod ldem me long rma bya'i sgro phod dar snas brgyan pa sogs spyi ltar/ phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas gser rdor rtse lnga pa nam mkhar 'phyar ba'i rwa rtse las me lce phra mo glog gi zegs ma lta bu'i rtse mo je sbom du song ba/ 'ja' gur gyi phyir sleb dus drag me zlum 'khyil du gyur pa'i nang du gu ru drag dmar dpa' gcig spyi 'gre zur zhal g.yon gzigs can/ gtso bo sku tshad mtho gang drag tsam la mtshon na gur drag sor gang tsam pa shin tu bkod legs/ thang ga che na gur drag de las drag po rigs bzhi/ shin tu chung ngu me phung klong du phra thabs su 'phro ba bris na legs kyang*/ thang chung la bri rgyu mang po de rigs mi legs pas gtso rkyang kho nas chog /phyag g.yon lte ba'i thad du mnyam gzhag mdzad pa'i steng bhandha dum bu gsum pa nor bu'i gang ba'i dbus su 'chi med tshe bum gser mdog rin po che'i rgyan ldan nor bus kha brgyan pa las mja' mtshon sna lnga rtsa ba phra ba rtse mo sbom pa zhig shar gyis 'phros pa'i rtser lha mo mgyogs ma lnga tshom mthing*/

dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang*/ g.yas thams cad mda' dar g.yob pa/ g.yon rang mdog gi tshe bum/ zhabs gar stabs bde nyams 'khyug pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sogs spyi ltar/ lnga ka bsdams pas gur drag gi sku tshad tsam/ de'ang gur drag dang*/ 'gyogs ma gnyis ka 'ja' gur gyi rgyab/ snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad tsam du yod pa/ mtho dman med pa'i cha snyoms dang gra 'grig zhig gal che/ gru mo g.yon du kha ṭwām̐ rtse gsum spyi ltar/ zhabs sag lham gsol zhing g.yas brkyang rgyal po rol stabs/ phyi rol du gzhi 'od zlum mthing ga la gser gyi zer thag dang mtha' skor du 'ja' gor kha dog lnga ldan shin tu mdzes pa'i rgyab tu shing lo me tog gang mdzes kyis bskor ba/ gdan seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs padma/ zla ba/ nyi ma ste bzhi brtsegs so/ /spyi bor 'ja' sprin gyi dbus su chos su sku snang ba mtha' yas dmar po/ phyag mnyam gzhag beḍūrya'i lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba/ sprul sku cha lugs sogs spyi 'gre/ gdan pad zla/ o rgyan gyi spyi bo dang bar du 'ja' 'od kyis sbrel ba/ de'i g.yas su cung dma' bar spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal bso g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon skyabs sbyin pad dkar/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan/ ri dwags pags pas nu g.yon bkab pa sogs spyi ltar/ zhabs phyed skyil/ gdan pad zla'o/ g.yon du yi dam yongs 'dus rta mgrin dmar smug /g.yas mtheb srin sbyar zhing sor mo lhag ma gsum bsgrengs pa'i dbang sdud kyi phyag rgyas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs ka /dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan khro nyams spyi ltar/ gshog pa sogs dpa' chas mi dgos/ yum mkha' 'gro kun 'dus rdo rje phag mo gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ rin chen dang rus rgyan gzigs sham can/ yab kyi spyi bor rta gdong ljang gu/ rngog ma dmar po/ zhur dkar po/

phrum phrum ser po nam mkhar zhal gdangs nas 'tsher ba/ yum gyi spyi bor phag gdong*/ yab yum zhal dngos su sbyor ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i dor stabs/ gdan padma/ nyi ma/ bdud bzhi ste g.yas su lha'i bu'i bdud dkar po zhi nyams/ nyon mongs mdud dmar po chags nyams/ g.yon du phung bdud ljang gu sgeg nyams/ 'chi bdud nag po khro nyams can rnams mgo g.yon du bstan nas bsgyel ba/ phyi rol du me ri pa tra'i rnam pa/ spyir rta mgrin 'di rnying ma'i gshin rje khros pa lta bu'i ha cang khro nyams mi che ba/ gsar ma'i drang srong khros pa las cung khro nyams tshe tsam dang*/ sku lus kyang 'gying zhing sgeg nyams las sbom thung lta bu mi bri/ thugs rje chen po'i 'og tu gter ston sangs rgyas bla ma sku sha rgyas shing brjid chags pa/ spyan zlum hrig ge ba/ zhal tshom cung zad yod pa/ dbu skra zlum 'khyil/ nang du gsang gos dkar po/ de steng gos rgya kha/ de steng stod le ser po brang gzhung du thor gcugs sbrel ba'i rgya gos lta bu/ de steng sku gzan dmar po zhig dkris pa/ rgyab tu ber dmar smug lhub gyon/ dbu zhwa padma saṃ zhu rna thung rgyab yod pa gser skud can/ phyag g.yas chos mchad/ g.yon mnyam gzhag steng gter gyi sgrom bu gdan rin po che'i khri chung dang dar 'bol/ rta mgrin 'og tu rtsa ba'i bla ma/ slob dpon rin po che'i 'og tu/ mgon po pho rgyud kyi gtso bo rgyud mgon legs ldan sku mdog mthing nag sbom zhing thung ba/ khro gnyer spyan gsum dbu skra smar smin kham nag /g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og /mchan g.yas tsandan gyi bing chen sgo gnyis pa rtse mor nor bus mtshan/ dar nag gi 'jom ber brtseg ma/ gser sked/ thod skam dbu rgyan rlon pa'i do shal dang*/ sbrul rgyan dang mi lpags sogs dur khrod chas/ zhabs sag lham yu ring gsol nas g.yon brkyang pa'i dor stabs/

gdan pad nyi dgra bgegs mi ro rta ro/ spyi bor bya khyung*/ dpung mgo gnyis nas seṅge/ rtsib logs gnyis nas 'phar dred/ zhabs las stag rnams 'phro ba/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa sogs spyi ltar/ legs ldan gyi g.yas cung zad dma' bar gnyis med rgyud kyi gtso bo ma ning mthing nag khro gtum/ g.yas ru mtshon 'phyar/ g.yon snying dang zhabs pa 'dzin/ spyan gsum dmar zlum sogs khro nyams spyi 'gro/ sprul nag gi ral pa thur du 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal/ snying phreng dang*/ sbrul chun/ dar nag gi 'jol ber brtsegs ma/ gser sked dang mi lpags kyi ske rags tsandan gyi bing chen sgo gsum pa rked par btsugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub/ zhabs g.yon brkyang dor stabs/ gdan pad nyi mi ro/ g.yon cung zad dma' bar srid pa mo rgyud kyi gtso mo e ka dza ṭi sku mdog smug nag /dpral bar spyan dmar zlum/ zhal nas tshems gcig ral pa kham nag thur du grol ba'i dbus nas lcags ral nag po nyag gcig gyen du langs pa/ thugs kar 'o ma 'dzag bzhin pa'i nu ma gcig 'phyang ba/ g.yas zhing dbyug klad la 'phyar/ g.yon dgra snying bzung zhing lcags spyang kha pha gyus pa khra thabs su 'gyed pa/ thod skam cod pan dang*/ thod skam gyi do shal/ mi lpags 'ja' sprin gyi stod g.yogs/ stag sham/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs/ gdan pad nyi/ mi ro/ ma ning g.yas cung zad dma' bar gnod sbyin nor lha'i gtso bo rnams sras sku mdog ser po/ g.yas rgyal mtshan g.yon ne'u le nor bu skyugs pa/ rin po che'i thor tshugs dang dbu rgyan/ dar gyi na bza' kha dog sna tshogs lhab lhub/ phrag gong g.yas su nyi ma/ g.yon du zla ba/ mdun du nor spungs/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i rol stabs kyis seng ge dkar mo nyal thabs kyis steng na bzhugs pa sogs spyi ltar dang*/

gdan sna tshogs/ padma/ nyi ma/ rnam sras kyi thad e ka dza ṭi g.yon du gter bdag gzhi bdag gi gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma dkar gsal zhi 'dzum/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje 'phyar/ g.yon gser gyi tshe bum nor bu'i kha rgyan can thugs kar/ nang gos ljang gu/ sku rags sngon po/ phyi gos dkar po gser ris can/ seng ge dkar mo la chibs pa/ gdan padma/ zla ba'o/ ༈ /legs ldan gyi mdun du 'ja' gur gyi dbus su mchod pa'i bye brag gtso bo thams cad pa'i nang du gtor ma rin chen 'bar ma dpe bris yongs grags ltar dang*/ de'i g.yas su sman phud snod zhi thod/ g.yon du rakta'i drag thod/ gtor ma'i mdun du rin po che'i pad gzhong du tshogs gtor la tshogs rdzas shing tog /la bug nya sha /khur ba/ thud sogs kyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas su rin po che'i phud kong gser skyems bcas/ g.yon du tshogs chang bdud rtsi'i thod pa bcas/ de'i mdun dang g.yas g.yon gang bder mchod yon rin po che'i pad phor kong bu yu ring gi rnam pa'i nang du mchod yon dkar pos khengs pa/ zhabs bsil dngul gyi bya ma bum/ gzhan me bum sogs nas rol mo'i bar spyi ltar dang*/ 'dod yon lnga rnams bkod mdzes/ de las rgyas na bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs bris kyang chog go ༈ /bsdu na slob dpon/ rigs bdag /thugs rje chen po zhi drag /gur drag dang mgyogs ma/ legs ldan/ rnam sras/ tshe ring ma tsam gyis mthus so// maṅga laṃ//
